text:
maya: Quick run — compared H100 int8 vs A100 fp16 across us-east / us-west / eu-west. Posting raw p50/p95 and notes below.
sanjay: Nice, drop the numbers when you have them.
maya: us-east H100 int8 p50=28ms p95=95ms; us-west H100 int8 p50=32ms p95=120ms; eu-west H100 int8 p50=40ms p95=210ms
liam: Whoa eu p95 is rough. Are those going through the edge proxy?
maya: Yes — default edge routing sends eu traffic via shared proxy in FRA. When I bypass the proxy (direct egress) eu p95 -> 110ms.
ari: Did kernel selection differ between regions? Could be a fallback to a slower kernel.
maya: Kernel log snippet: ```kernel_select: cuBLASLt_optimized_v2 if seq_len < 512 else generic_attention_v1
Note: eu nodes sometimes pick generic_attention_v1 for int8 when warmup samples are low```
perf-bot: Automated check: warmup_samples < 20 => force generic kernel. Canary had warmup=10.
sanjay: @maya can we increase warmup or bias routing to prefer local H100 pool in eu?
maya: Tried warmup=50 on eu H100s: p95 drops to ~130ms (still above us-east). Combining warmup=50 + direct routing yields ~90-120ms p95.
liam: Any model quality regressions observed with int8 quant?
maya: evals: small BLEU drop ~0.3, no major regressions on our validation set. Running heavy chat regressions now.
ari: Capacity/throughput note: H100 int8 throughput ~320 req/s (seq=256); A100 fp16 ~210 req/s. So routing to H100 is cost-effective even with some tail.
sanjay: Proposed plan: increase warmup default to 40 for region eu-west, prefer local H100 via routing policy, and add fallback to A100 for kernel mismatch > threshold. Roll out as canary.
maya: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/merge/1234 (adds warmup tweak + region preference)
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for routing-policy v2 at 1777777805 :rocket:
liam: Post-canary checklist: monitor p95, kernel hit-rate, and cpu proxy egress latency. If eu generic kernel > 5% revert or escalate.
maya: :thumbsup: I'll add dashboards and an alert rule on kernel_hit_rate and p95 > 150ms for eu-west.
